trailhead.label: The centre of Gardola, Tignale, the published start

cautions: About 0.5 km of mountain path (T2) on the climb to the sanctuary: stony and steeper in places; sure footing needed.
About a third on village lanes and cobbled streets in Gardola, with a crossing of the SP38: keep your dog on a short lead there.
The sanctuary sits on a rocky spur with drops beside the terraces: keep your dog close at the top.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
